parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix. Only columns of text type from the input counts matrix are available to select for this parameter.

parameters.name: Significance column
parameters.description: Column name for significance, such as pval or adjpval.

parameters.name: Significance cutoff
parameters.description: Features are kept only if their significance_column value is less than this cutoff threshold.

parameters.name: Change column
parameters.description: Column name for change, such as logFC.

parameters.name: Change cutoff
parameters.description: Features are kept only if the absolute value of their change_column value is greater than or equal to this cutoff threshold.

parameters.name: Filtering mode
parameters.description: Accepted values are any or all, to include features that meet the criteria in any contrast or in all contrasts.

parameters.name: Include estimates
parameters.description: Column names of estimates to include.

parameters.name: Round estimates
parameters.description: Whether to round estimates.

parameters.name: Contrast filter
parameters.description: Whether to filter contrasts in or out of analysis. If keep, only the contrast names listed in contrasts are included. If remove, the contrast names listed by contrasts are removed. If none, all contrasts in the dataset are used.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Contrast names to filter by contrast_filter. If contrast_filter is none, this parameter has no effect.

parameters.name: Groups
parameters.description: Group names to filter by groups_filter. If groups_filter is none, this parameter has no effect.

parameters.name: Groups filter
parameters.description: Whether to filter groups in or out of analysis. If keep, only the group names listed in groups are included. If remove, the group names listed by groups are removed. If none, all groups in the dataset are used.

parameters.name: Rounding decimals for percent
parameters.description: Decimal place to use when rounding Percent cells.

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Font size for labels in the plot.

parameters.name: Label distance
parameters.description: Distance of labels from the bars.

parameters.name: Y-axis expansion
parameters.description: Expansion of the y-axis.

parameters.name: Fill colors
parameters.description: Fill colors for the bars.

parameters.name: Pie chart in 3D
parameters.description: Whether to draw pie charts in 3D.

parameters.name: Bar width
parameters.description: Width of the bars.

parameters.name: Draw bar border
parameters.description: Whether to draw borders around bars.

parameters.name: Plot type
parameters.description: Plot type, either bar or pie.

parameters.name: Plot titles fontsize
parameters.description: Font size for plot titles.
